messages:
sasha: Heads up — multiple customers reporting elevated 502/504s and timeouts on hosted inference endpoints in us-west over the last 20m. Tickets opened by Acme and NorthernLabs. High customer impact, escalated to incidents.
liam: Confirmed. P50 latency + p95 errors spike on apigw->runtime. Spinning up warroom. @maya you on call for infra?
maya: On it. Initial dashboards show backend 502 rate up ~8% across generation endpoints. Error traces show upstream connection resets: "http: upstream closed connection" and a spike in TLS churn.
ethan: We're seeing a surge of long-lived streaming requests that keep connections open ~30-60s. New edge-pool canary (edge-v2) was routed 30m ago for ~15% traffic. Could be keepalive / connection pool mismatch.
sasha: Customers say requests return "502 Bad Gateway" when they stream longer than ~25s. Support repro: single request occasionally fails, then retries succeed.
liam: Ops-bot, post recent deploys and routing changes for us-west in last hour.
ops-bot: deploys: edge-v2 canary routing policy applied at 2023-11-14T20:42:17Z to us-west; no runtime deploys in last hour.
maya: Correlating: 502 spike started ~5m after canary roll. Edge-v2 uses shorter downstream keepalive (15s) while runtime expects 30s. When client streaming exceeds downstream keepalive, edge closes and upstream returns reset -> 502.
ethan: Repro steps (local):

  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"long stream start","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate | sed -n '1,200p'

After ~20-30s the connection sometimes drops with: "recv: connection reset by peer" and server logs show upstream closed before KV flush.
sasha: Customer repro steps included too, attaching their minimal curl that failed.
liam: Immediate mitigation options?
maya: 1) Rollback canary routing to stop hitting edge-v2 (low blast radius). 2) Increase edge-v2 downstream keepalive to 60s and connection pool max for a quick config push. 3) Add routing rule to send streaming endpoints to edge-v1 only.
ethan: Quick fix: rolling back canary now will stop new sessions on edge-v2. We'll also enable a short-lived fallback: if upstream resets, auto-retry once with sticky route to edge-v1.
liam: Do rollback, then monitor. @ethan implement fallback retry and set feature flag.
ethan: Rolling back canary now -> executing route-change command.
ops-bot: routing-change: traffic for edge-v2 in us-west set to 0% at 2023-11-14T21:05:02Z by liam.
maya: After rollback, 502 rate dropped back to baseline in ~3m. Customer tickets reporting recovery. Good.
sasha: Communicated to Acme and NorthernLabs: apology + short note that canary rollback reduced errors; on followup we will share root cause and action items.
liam: Postmortem checklist / action items:
  - ethan: implement auto-fallback retry for streaming endpoints on upstream reset (P1, owner ethan, ETA 3d).
  - maya: add canary gating test for keepalive/streaming behavior in edge rollout runbook (P1, owner maya, ETA 2d).
  - infra: standardize keepalive defaults across edge and runtime configs and add deployment guard (P1, owner: infra team, ETA 5d).
  - support: template customer comms and run replay with affected customers (P2, owner sasha, ETA 1d).
  - eng: add synthetic long-stream healthcheck hitting canary for >60s streaming to detect regressions during canary (P1, owner ethan & maya, ETA 4d).

maya: Added an alert rule for TLS churn/connection_reset count > 20/min (P0). Also creating dashboard panel that slices 502s by edge-pool.
ethan: I'll open PRs for fallback and healthcheck and tag for review.
sasha: I'll follow up with customers with a short RCA draft once we have the final root cause.
liam: Good remediation plan. Postmortem sync tomorrow 10:30am PST. Add owners to tracker and add links in the incident ticket.
ops-bot: incident-8470013379 created and assigned. Incident severity: Sev2. Timeline and notes attached.
maya: Quick note for the postmortem: include exact timing (canary applied -> 502 increase -> rollback -> drop). Also include test matrix that failed to catch keepalive mismatch.
ethan: Logging improvement action: log upstream close reason + edge pool id in runtime logs (owner ethan, ETA 3d).
sasha: Closing loop: tickets will remain open until we confirm fixes in canary rollout. Will update customers after postmortem.
liam: Thanks team. If anyone needs to escalate to leadership or SRE leads, ping me. :thumbsup:
summary: Canary edge pool routing changed keepalive behavior causing upstream connection resets for long-lived streaming requests -> 502/504 spikes. Mitigation: rollback canary, implement fallback retry, standardize keepalive defaults, add synthetic long-stream healthchecks, and owner-assigned action items for postmortem.
